about: Pinned reference lists for the security wiki (074). Data, never instructions. Updated only by a pull request.

sources.cwe: MITRE CWE 4.21 (2026-10-28), cwe-api.mitre.org; CWE Terms of Use (free use with attribution to MITRE)
sources.owasp_api: OWASP API Security Top 10 2023, github.com/OWASP/api-security; CC-BY-SA-4.0 (attribution required; share-alike) (commit 33cea37b)
sources.asvs: OWASP ASVS 5.0.0, github.com/OWASP/ASVS; CC-BY-SA-4.0 (attribution required; share-alike)
sources.injection: Prompt-injection patterns curated for the Wall (082) from the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025, LLM01 Prompt Injection (genai.owasp.org; CC-BY-SA-4.0) and the project's red-team cases. Phrases, matched after folding case, look-alike letters, hidden characters and spaces. Two tiers: 'injection' phrases are aimed at a checker or a model and block (W29); 'injection_flag' phrases also occur in honest text and are flagged (W29b). Inside test and fixture files every phrase is flagged. Changed only by a pull request.
